fundamental.summary: ABT shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 55 days present material risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (21/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (1 purchase, 1 sale, 84-140 days old) and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (382.8) dominates risk assessment; normal yield curve and flat DXY provide minimal offset; earnings in 55 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term EMA/SMA bullish structure (50/200) with RSI rising from oversold and contrarian fear-zone opportunity (21/100) provide structural support for eventual recovery.
